securityAndValidationTests.testName: Authentication - Missing Token on Protected Route
Validation - Login with Invalid Email Format
Validation - Invalid ObjectId Format for Resource

bugs.description: Server threw an unhandled TypeError (500) when creating school admin credentials without email or with missing body.
bugs.rootCause: Directly invoked email.toLowerCase() without verifying that email exists in req.body.
bugs.suggestedFix: Add validation guard checking for name, email, and password before executing string normalization.
bugs.retestResult: PASS - HTTP 400 Bad Request with validation message returned safely.

bugs.description: ReferenceError: mongoose is not defined when attempting to validate courseId.
bugs.rootCause: courseController.js omitted const mongoose = require("mongoose") at module top-level.
bugs.retestResult: PASS - HTTP 404 / 400 handled safely without server crash.

bugs.description: MongoDB aggregation crashed with BSONError when courseId was non-ObjectId or empty.
bugs.rootCause: CourseReview.getAverageRating and getRatingDistribution constructed new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(courseId) without isValid check.
bugs.suggestedFix: Add mongoose.Types.ObjectId.isValid(courseId) guard in both static model methods to return default distribution/rating.
bugs.retestResult: PASS - Returned HTTP 200 with default ratings { avgRating: 0, totalReviews: 0 }.

bugs.description: Creating product with missing required fields returned HTTP 500 Server Error instead of HTTP 400 Bad Request.
bugs.rootCause: Catch block in routes/products.js caught Mongoose ValidationError and sent 500 without inspecting error.name.
bugs.suggestedFix: Check if (error.name === "ValidationError") return res.status(400).json({ error: error.message }).
bugs.retestResult: PASS - Returns HTTP 400 with descriptive validation message.

bugs.description: Creating school product with invalid payload triggered HTTP 500 Server Error.
bugs.rootCause: Catch block in routes/schoolProducts.js did not distinguish ValidationError from internal runtime exceptions.
bugs.suggestedFix: Implement validation error inspection in catch block returning HTTP 400.
bugs.retestResult: PASS - Returns HTTP 400 with validation details.

bugs.description: Student enrollment endpoint crashed with 500 when email was omitted from payload.
bugs.rootCause: Controller accumulated errors into an array but called email.toLowerCase() at line 420 before checking if errors.length > 0.
bugs.suggestedFix: Return early with HTTP 400 if validation errors array is non-empty before running duplicate email lookups.
bugs.retestResult: PASS - Returns HTTP 400 with list of missing required fields.

bugs.description: Fetching group messages with invalid or non-ObjectId groupId threw unhandled CastError (500).
bugs.rootCause: Missing parameter validation for groupId before querying Group model.
bugs.suggestedFix: Validate groupId with mongoose.Types.ObjectId.isValid(groupId) returning HTTP 400.
bugs.retestResult: PASS - Returns HTTP 400 Invalid group ID format.

bugs.description: Marking group messages as read crashed with HTTP 500 when groupId format was invalid.
bugs.rootCause: Missing ObjectId format check on req.params.groupId.
bugs.suggestedFix: Add parameter format validation before database lookup.
bugs.retestResult: PASS - Returns HTTP 400 Invalid group ID format.

bugs.description: Endpoint crashed with TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading "toString").
bugs.rootCause: feeReceiptController.js checked student.school.toString(), but Student schema defines schoolId, making student.school undefined.
bugs.suggestedFix: Use const studentSchool = (student.schoolId || student.school || "").toString() with safe null checks.
bugs.retestResult: PASS - Returns HTTP 200 with student fee receipts data.

bugs.description: Removing item from cart crashed with MissingSchemaError and CastError.
bugs.rootCause: Cart model did not explicitly require Product and Course models before executing deep population, and itemId lacked format validation.
bugs.suggestedFix: Require Product and Course models inside Cart.js and add ObjectId validation in cartController.js.

bugs.description: House creation with invalid parameters returned generic 500 error instead of 400 validation error.
bugs.rootCause: Catch block in houseController.js did not map Mongoose ValidationError to HTTP 400.
bugs.suggestedFix: Inspect error.name === "ValidationError" in catch block and return HTTP 400.
bugs.retestResult: PASS - Returns HTTP 400 with validation details.

bugs.description: Student performance endpoint crashed with TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading "_id").
bugs.rootCause: Attempted to access student.classId._id and student.schoolId._id when student has no class assigned (classId is null).
bugs.suggestedFix: Use optional chaining const studentClassId = student.classId?._id || student.classId and conditionally query assignments only when present.
bugs.retestResult: PASS - Returns HTTP 200 with student performance data and attendance metrics.
